Windows delay-load samples
==========================

No sample for delay-load imports is built here. The mingw-w64 linker has no
option that writes a delay-load import table (data directory 13); the table
only comes from the Microsoft linker's /DELAYLOAD option or from a separate
helper library.

Tests that need a program with delay-load imports build the bytes in test code
(see tests/DepFixtures.hpp): a PE32+ header with an import table naming one
library and a delay-load table naming another, laid out by hand. Nothing in
this folder is read for them.
